Liam (SDK): Heads up — onboarding sampleapp is producing duplicated work items for a subset of users. Repro steps: 1) create session -> 2) token refresh triggers during streaming -> 3) request gets 429 then client retries and server processes twice.
Maya (DevEx): ugh. do we have simple repro logs? can you paste the trace id?
Liam (SDK): trace=tr-3f9a, attached snippet below. you can see client retry loop runs while auth refresh is inflight.
Liam (SDK): ```
[2026-03-21T14:02:12Z] send req id=abc123 session=xyz token=expiring
[2026-03-21T14:02:12Z] auth: refresh started for user u-42
[2026-03-21T14:02:13Z] recv 429 retry-after=0.2 id=abc123
[2026-03-21T14:02:13Z] sdk: retrying request id=abc123 (attempt 2)
[2026-03-21T14:02:13Z] server: processed id=abc123 (duplicate)
```
Sam (Auth): thanks — this matches a race we saw last month where the refresh promise resolves after the SDK already started a retry. If the retry uses a new auth token but the server treats the second request as "new" and replays side-effects, we need an idempotency guard.
Maya (DevEx): are we doing Idempotency-Key today? i thought only some endpoints accepted it.
Natalie (Platform): currently only write-ish endpoints accept Idempotency-Key. streaming/generation endpoints treat each request as independent. we can expand, but need to be mindful of cache keys and KV growth.
Liam (SDK): proposal: SDK should attach an idempotency key by default for single-shot non-streaming calls and include a replay-safe header for streaming resume points. For retries triggered by 429/5xx, if token refresh is in-flight, pause and await refresh for a short window before retrying.
Sam (Auth): pausing for auth is fine, but streaming complicates things. For full parity between Node/Python: node currently retries immediately, python waits for refresh — that's why some users hit dup task only on node. we should align behavior.
Maya (DevEx): agree — parity is important for onboarding friction. can we standardize the algorithm? something like: on transient error (429/502/503): if authRefreshInFlight then wait min( refreshTimeout, backoffBase ) then retry using full jitter backoff.
Liam (SDK): suggested backoff snippet: ```
// full jitter exponential backoff
function backoffMs(attempt) {
  const base = 100; // ms
  const cap = 2000; // ms
  const temp = Math.min(cap, base * Math.pow(2, attempt));
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * temp);
}
```
Sam (Auth): that pattern is good. also recommend SDK send Idempotency-Key header by default for any request that can cause side-effects. simple uuid per logical user action. server should treat repeated idempotency keys as dedupe.
Natalie (Platform): server-side dedupe is fine but we need to decide TTL for idempotency entries (24h?), and storage costs. For onboarding sampleapp where traffic is low, TTL=1h might suffice. we can tune.
Maya (DevEx): action items: 1) Liam: add auth-wait-before-retry with 250ms soft-window + full jitter backoff and default Idempotency-Key for non-streaming requests in SDKs. 2) Sam + Natalie: agree idempotency header semantics and TTL for sampleapp endpoints; add a server-side dedupe metric. 3) DevEx: update sampleapp onboarding doc to call out node/python parity and recommended patch.
Liam (SDK): i'll open a PR with the SDK change and unit tests that simulate auth refresh races. will add a small e2e in sampleapp.
Sam (Auth): i'll add server dedupe support behind a feature flag to keep rollout safe. will also add a metric "idempotency.dedupe_count".
deploy-bot: deploy queued: sampleapp/feature/replay-protections -> staging (job #4821).
Maya (DevEx): sweet. once PRs land i can validate with the onboarding checklist. thanks team :thumbsup:
Liam (SDK): thanks all — want to avoid more "ghost" duplicate tasks in customer demos. will update thread with PR links.
Maya (DevEx): ping here when PRs are ready, i'll run the onboarding flow and report results.
